QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Leader of the Dispatch
QuestInfo.0: Vice Captain Butler is annoyed you aren't continuing on, claiming that giving people time to think will only make it easier for them to panic. He then storms off shouting about how you should hand command over to him if you're not tough enough to handle the pressure.
